div.head: Grið 31.1
div.ab: Forðam ælc cyricgrið is Cristenes agen grið; 7 ælc Cristen man ah micle þearfe, þæt he on ðam griðe mycle mæþe wite.
Forðam ælc cyricgrið is Cristes agen grið, and ælc Cristen man ah micle þearfe þæt he on ðam griðe mycle mæþe wite.
Denn jeder von einer Kirche [ausgehende] Sonderfriede ist Christi eigener Sonderfriede; und jeder Christenmensch hat stark die Pflicht, dass er vor diesem Sonderfrieden grosse Hochachtung empfinde.
For every special peace [proceeding] from a church is Christ's own special peace; and every Christian person has a great duty to feel great respect for this special peace.
Therefore, every church sanctuary is Christ’s own sanctuary, and every Christian has a fundamental responsibility to hold that sanctuary in great reverence.
div.note: G reads ‘Cristenes’; Liebermann would correct to ‘Cristes’ (as column T has it). Liebermann compares I Cn 2.1. In G, VIII Atr. follows in the same hand. Grið ends here.
